beats.text: The villain is the memory bus, a constant, chaotic relay race where data drops every time it switches between processors.
beats.visual_focus: Animated data packets colliding at a bottleneck junction.

beats.text: GenieX shatters this wall using Heterogeneous Kernel Fusion, merging disparate compute tasks into one single, high-speed execution stream.
beats.visual_focus: Three separate processing lanes merging into one high-velocity highway.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—calling my phone a 'glorified paperweight' is exactly what happens when I try to run local LLMs. I liked the focus on the memory bus bottleneck. However, 'Heterogeneous Kernel Fusion' sounds like a buzzword salad unless you actually explain that you're basically batching operations to keep the cache warm. You lost me for a split second there, but the performance metrics in Beat 5 brought me back.
